value.name: reveals revised will terms
value.description: The document states that 1247 Pemberton Street will go to Lucia and Daniel's cash bequest will be increased, while everything else remains unchanged.
evidence: the real property known as 1247 Pemberton Street, Philadelphia, was to be devised to Lucia Marie Serrano. The cash bequest to Daniel was to be increased by a specified sum. Everything else stood.

value.name: Asha shows Daniel the will
value.description: Asha reads the revised will twice and hands it to Daniel to inspect.
evidence: Asha read it twice. Then she handed it to Daniel.

value.name: Daniel questions signature authenticity
value.description: Daniel reads the document and immediately claims the signature is not his mother's.
evidence: He read it once. His face did not change. He handed it back.
"That's not her signature," he said.
"That is not my mother's signature."

value.name: Asha offers signature verification
value.description: Asha insists they have many examples of the mother's signature and says the document can be analyzed to confirm it.
evidence: "We have her signature on twenty other documents in this house and on file with the bank. We can have it analyzed if you want. It will come back as hers."

value.name: Daniel demands analysis and depositions
value.description: Daniel escalates the dispute by demanding forensic analysis and witness depositions.
evidence: "I want it analyzed."
"I want it analyzed and I want the witnesses deposed and I want—"

value.name: Lucia interrupts Daniel
value.description: Lucia enters holding the letter and tells Daniel to stop pressing the issue.
evidence: "Daniel." It was Lucia. She had come in behind them. She was holding the letter in her hand. The letter from the side table drawer. "Daniel, please stop."

value.name: Daniel confronts Lucia about the letter
value.description: Daniel turns to Lucia and demands to know what the letter is and when she found it.
evidence: He turned to her. "What is that."
"A letter. From Mom. To me."
"When did you find that."
"Three days before Asha came."

value.name: Lucia admits hiding the letter
value.description: Lucia reveals she did not tell Daniel or anyone else about the letter and only told Asha two nights earlier.
evidence: "You found a letter and you didn't tell me."
"I didn't tell anyone. I told Asha two nights ago."

value.name: Daniel sits down in shock
value.description: Overwhelmed by the revelation, Daniel looks between Lucia and Asha and collapses into a chair.
evidence: "You—" He stopped. He looked at Asha. He looked at Lucia. He looked at the room, the small bright sewing room with the window onto the wisteria. He sat down, abruptly, on the chair by the worktable. He sat the way a man sits when his legs have decided for him.

value.name: Daniel orders the letter read aloud
value.description: Daniel asks Lucia to read the letter, and she begins reading it carefully without dramatizing it.
evidence: "Read it," he said.
"Daniel."
"Read it."
Lucia read the letter out loud. She read it carefully and without performance. She did not skip the parts about him.
